QuestInfo.name: Pia's Mischievous Wish
QuestInfo.0: #p218# over at #m10001050# seems to be mulling over what she'd like for her birthday present.
QuestInfo.1: I met #b#p218##k at #m10001050#, and with a mischievous look on her face, she said what she'd really like as a birthday present is a #b#t4031008##k. The trouble is, that's the very same precious item #p204# once gave to #p225# as a birthday present... I'd better head back to #b#p204##k first. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: #p204# was taken aback to hear what #p218# wants for her birthday.

0.0: Alright, listen. Isn't it possible that some people just don't like giving and receiving birthday presents? Whenever I get something, I feel like I have to give something back, and that's such a hassle, you know? But it doesn't look like #p204# has any intention of giving up on this.
0.1: Hmm... let's see~ Okay, I've got it. For my birthday this year, I want a #b#t4031008##k. Yep, that's right. The one #p204# gave to #p225# as a present before. It looked so pretty, all sparkly like that. There, happy now? So go on and tell #p204# that already, haha!

yes.0: Oh, that reminds me, you've met #p225# before, haven't you? Did he seem like he was doing well? Ahem... I mean, it's not like there's anything wrong with wondering how a friend's doing, is there? A-anyway, go on and head back to #p204# already.

1.0: You’re back. Did #p218# tell you what they wanted? What…? They said #p218# wants a #t4031008# for their birthday? Oh dear…

npc.0: I wonder when #p225#'s going to come visit #m10001000#... Huh? You're still standing there? Go on, go see #p204# already.
